get_cluster_type: get the detected cluster type (AWS, FAIR, or RSC) from the current machine
get_checkpoint_path: get the root checkpoint directory path for the current cluster type
get_user_checkpoint_path: get the user-specific checkpoint path under the cluster's checkpoint directory
get_slurm_partition: get the default SLURM partition name for the current cluster type
get_slurm_executor_parameters: get SLURM executor parameters with cluster-specific defaults for nodes and GPUs
